# fun-tree_plot
```{r fun-tree_plot}
# Function for tree plot
id_tree <- function(df, pop = "Roster", vars) {
  
combine_strings <- function(...) {
  pathString <- paste(na.omit(c(...)), collapse = "/")
  pathString <- sub("/$", "", pathString)
  pathString <- gsub("NA/", "", pathString)
  return(pathString)
}

data_string <- df |> 
  filter(ageYears >= 15) |>
  labelled::to_factor() |>
  mutate(source = pop) |>
  select(source, vars) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), to_factor),
         across(everything(), ~ case_when(. %in% c("Don't know", "98", "99") ~ "DK", TRUE ~ .))) |> #data.tree can't handle apostrophes
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character),
         pathString = combine_strings(across(everything()))) |>
  ungroup() 
  
data_sum <- data_string |>
  group_by(pathString)  |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  to_factor() |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  mutate(pathString = paste(pathString, n, sep = "\n"))

# Set up data.tree object
data_tree <- as.Node(data_sum)

# Data tree style
SetGraphStyle(data_tree, rankdir = "LR")
SetEdgeStyle(data_tree, arrowhead = "vee", color = "grey35", penwidth = 2)

SetConditionalNodeStyle <- function(node) {
  if (grepl("[0-9]", node$name) & !grepl("NA", node$name)) {
    SetNodeStyle(node, style = "filled,rounded", shape = "box", fillcolor = "#0072BC", 
                 fontname = "lato", tooltip = GetDefaultTooltip,
                 fontcolor = "#FAEB00")
  } else {
    SetNodeStyle(node, style = "filled,rounded", shape = "box", fillcolor = "white", 
                 fontname = "lato", tooltip = GetDefaultTooltip,
                 fontcolor = "black")
  }
}

data_tree$Do(function(node) SetConditionalNodeStyle(node))

tree_plot <- plot(data_tree)

return(data_tree)
}
```
